annotations.text:
Integrated Todo-centric home. Three connected axes, not separate screens:
• Todo = work item   • Kanban = lifecycle (lane)   • Session/agent = executor
Drill-down left→right: Project (product) → Node (sub-goal) → Todo → [Todo detail | Kanban]. A node's live sessions show as an agent on the todo/lane they execute; click the agent → its work summary. New sessions start from the bottom dock's +. FleetHome is the earlier sketch kept for reference. Low-fi mockup, Universe tokens (#191a1d / #212327 / #31333a, teal #6f9b93).

Galaxy = full-screen view mode (Esc → Home). far → system → near zoom. Inspector lives inside Galaxy. Matches Universe app tokens. Static mockup; backend serves projection.views (galaxy 9 · functional 12 · structural 12 · flow 26 · knowledge 74 · kanban 24).
